answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with walks capped at L steps from independently anchored vertices, while limiting each node’s vote. A sybil cluster joined to honest nodes by a sparse cut has low conductance, so little walk mass crosses its boundary, mathematically bounding its aggregate voting weight by external trusted flow rather than internal size. Even an ocean of identities cannot turn a zephyr-thin bridge into broad trust; propagation must not spiral past the bound.
